author: insanegguy
body: So you gave me the evidence but didn't let me explain at all. So here's where i shall do this, hopefully it isn't closed without being read. Izzy or Ihze in game is one of my friends on Avicus. He's someone who is on the same team as me and someone I play with occasionally. Why would I insult him with intent if he was my friend? Also to mention the slur couldn't even apply to him. It was said in a joking way. Also I only said it twice, why would that warrant such a ban? Also if you asked him i am positive he would testify that I was joking. So please consider appealing my ban.
